_meta.title: Daily sweep 2026-05-15..17 — Microsoft MDASH new CyberGym SOTA + CurveBench + Muse Spark CyberGym + SVC GPT-5.2
_meta.scope: 48-hour daily sweep. Frontier vendor week quiet (zero new SKUs from OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/etc). Key wins: Microsoft MDASH multi-agent system breaks CyberGym at 88.45% (new SOTA, +5pp over Mythos Preview 83.1%); CurveBench new academic benchmark with Gemini 3.1 Pro 71.1%/19.1% Easy/Hard; Muse Spark CyberGym backfill.

models.name: MDASH (Multi-model Agentic Scanning Harness)
models._note: Microsoft multi-agent security system orchestrating >100 specialized AI agents. NEW SOTA on CyberGym at 88.45% — 5pp ahead of next entry (Claude Mythos Preview 83.1%). System-level harness, not a single model SKU.

benchmarks.name: CurveBench
benchmarks.description: Benchmark for exact topological reasoning over nested Jordan curves. 756 images × 5 difficulty levels. arxiv 2605.14068 (May 13 2026). Gemini 3.1 Pro 71.1% Easy / 19.1% Hard at release.

benchmarks.name: CurveBench (Easy)
benchmarks.description: CurveBench Easy split — basic Jordan curve topological reasoning.

benchmarks.name: CurveBench (Hard)
benchmarks.description: CurveBench Hard split — challenging Jordan curve topological reasoning.

benchmarks.name: MemLens
benchmarks.description: Multimodal Long-Term Memory benchmark for large VLMs. 789 questions × 4 context lengths (32K-256K) × 5 memory abilities. 27 VLMs + 7 memory agents tested. arxiv 2605.14906 (May 14 2026).

benchmarks.name: MemEye
benchmarks.description: Visual-centric evaluation framework for multimodal agent memory. 8 life-scenario tasks × 13 memory methods × 4 VLM backbones. arxiv 2605.15128 (May 14 2026).

benchmarks.name: ViMU (Video Metaphorical Understanding)
benchmarks.description: Video subtext understanding: metaphor / irony / social commentary. Hint-free open-ended + MCQ. arxiv 2605.14607 (May 14 2026).

benchmarks.name: PROVE-Bench
benchmarks.description: Perceptual RemOVal cohErence Benchmark for Visual Media. PROVE-M (80 paired videos) + PROVE-H (100 challenge videos). RC-S/RC-T metrics. arxiv 2605.14534 (May 14 2026).

benchmarks.name: Signature Verification Challenge (mobile random forgery EER)
benchmarks.description: Online signature verification challenge — mobile random forgery Equal Error Rate. arxiv 2605.14845 (May 14 2026). GPT-5.2 0.32% EER reported.

scores._note: NEW SOTA. Microsoft multi-agent system orchestrating >100 specialized AI agents. ~5pp ahead of next entry (Mythos Preview 83.1%).
